title: TLS on the wire: downgrade, stripping and a certificate nobody validated

videos.script: TLS is not broken by somebody on the path, when it is set up properly. What fails is the setup. {{setup}} This lesson takes three ways around TLS that leave the cryptography untouched. An old version both ends still accept. A first request sent in plain HTTP, before any encryption starts. And a client that never checked whose certificate it was shown. {{three}} You will find which versions the shop accepts, and see the server refuse an old one. You will add one header that makes browsers skip plain HTTP entirely. {{hsts}} Then a machine that is not the shop claims to be it. The check refuses it, and one flag makes the refusal go away. {{impostor}} Last, how to find that flag in code before somebody else does. {{code}}
